# `network/groupLedger/GovernancePolicy.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/groupLedger/GovernancePolicy.js`

network/groupLedger/GovernancePolicy.js — group governance modes on top of the CSE PolicyEngine (network plan §16 "adminless and moderatorless groups"): unanimous / majority / threshold / founder-protected / open-capability. This module decides WHETHER a given vote/approval set is enough for a governance action to commit; GroupLedger.js decides WHAT happens once it does.

## Functions

### `createGovernancePolicy({ mode = GOVERNANCE_MODES.MAJORITY, founders = ()`

Build a governance policy for a group.

**Parameters:**

- `c` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[c.mode]` *(string)* — one of GOVERNANCE_MODES
- `[c.founders]` *(() => Set<string>)* — live founder membershipId set
- `[c.memberCount]` *(() => number)* — live member count
- `[c.threshold]` *(number)* — required approvals for THRESHOLD mode

**Returns:** }

## Constants

- `GOVERNANCE_MODES`
- `IRREVERSIBLE_ACTIONS` — Governance actions that always require approval (network plan §17 eviction/bans).
